missions.title: Dynamic Provider Plugin Foundation
missions.why_now: All future providers and local runtimes depend on a stable extension boundary.
acceptance_tests: External plugin discovered without core edit
missions.rollback: Retain static provider map as compatibility fallback; git revert <commit>.

missions.title: Versioned Benchmark DSL
missions.why_now: Benchmark authoring and reproducibility are the next scaling bottleneck.
missions.rollback: Keep legacy JSONL as default and feature-flag DSL loading.

missions.title: Judge Ensemble Core
missions.why_now: Routing and research conclusions require a stronger evaluation basis.
acceptance_tests: Missing judge result cannot silently pass
missions.rollback: Retain the current single-scorer path behind a compatibility flag.

missions.title: Statistical Confidence and Reproducibility
missions.why_now: Optimization and regression decisions require quantified uncertainty.
missions.rollback: Keep statistics additive and do not change verdict semantics initially.

missions.title: OpenTelemetry Foundation
missions.why_now: Distributed work and APIs need end-to-end correlation.
acceptance_tests: Every execution links to a run trace
Telemetry failures do not fail benchmarks
Secrets do not appear in span attributes
missions.rollback: Keep telemetry feature-flagged with a no-op default exporter.

missions.title: REST API and Python SDK
missions.why_now: The harness becomes reusable infrastructure only when callers can embed it.
missions.rollback: Keep CLI as primary entry point and API additive.

missions.title: Distributed Coordinator and Worker Prototype
missions.why_now: Scaling should follow stable contracts, manifests, telemetry, and APIs.
acceptance_tests: Worker crash does not lose work
missions.rollback: Keep local runner as default and distributed mode feature-flagged.

missions.title: Explainable Cost/Latency/Quality Router
missions.why_now: Optimization is safe only after metadata, evaluation confidence, and telemetry are trustworthy.
missions.rollback: Keep explicit model selection as default; automatic routing stays feature-flagged.
